notes.title: Update notifications on Windows and Android
notes.detail: an update button appears when a new build is out; it shows what's new and installs the update in place. On Windows you choose Restart now or When I close the app, and SmarterHumans reopens on the new version by itself.

notes.title: Windows installs and updates through Velopack
notes.detail: later updates download only what changed, and the installer and app are signed, so Windows names SmarterHumans as the publisher.

notes.title: Redaction groups
notes.detail: group redactions, and numbering now starts at 1 on every platform.

notes.title: Import and Sync settings in a new design
Web import introduction at launch
Get started guides for Notes and the Library
Auto summary setting
notes.detail: turn automatic summaries on or off in Settings → AI → General, and create a summary for any document with "Create summary".

notes.title: AI Settings in the AI Playground
notes.detail: choose the language of generated flashcards, or let the app detect it.

notes.title: Installed version in Settings → What's New on Mac, iPhone and iPad
notes.detail: the same line Windows and Android show.

notes.title: Runs on older devices
notes.detail: macOS 15, iOS 18, Android 11 and Windows 10 version 1809 (x64) are now supported.

notes.title: Large libraries and typing in Notes are faster
Text is easier to read in light and dark mode
notes.detail: placeholders, links, buttons and the selected segment meet WCAG AA contrast.

notes.title: Video and podcast transcripts work without your own Supadata key
A note needs a title
Tag sorting is consistent
notes.detail: "Created" reverses with the arrow, and each sort word means one thing.

notes.title: Practice settings reworked
Self-contained AI flashcard questions
notes.detail: generated questions no longer depend on the text they came from.

notes.title: Notes and concepts from a video stay separate
notes.detail: they are no longer collected into one master note.

notes.title: Older built-in PDF reader removed
macOS no longer asks for the login-keychain password
Dictation no longer types "[BLANK_AUDIO]"
notes.detail: it follows your language, and falls back to Whisper when Apple has no speech assets.

notes.title: Web-imported cards reach your other devices with source, highlights and tags
Web video cards get their transcript marker and Source seek
Summaries for imported videos
notes.detail: a video is summarized once its transcript has loaded.

notes.title: Web pages imported from a link render correctly
Snip flashcards use your own OpenRouter key when one is set
Concepts from a video or podcast no longer titled "page 0"
No surprise flashcard generation
notes.detail: returning to a video or podcast with the AI Playground open no longer starts generating by itself.

notes.title: The document is disabled while the AI Playground form is open
A restored card is no longer blanked by an empty editor
notes.detail: and **note links break words at punctuation**
